title: 反相加法器：把直流和交流加在一起
summary: 两路输入经 47 kΩ 和 10 kΩ 汇到虚地：开关接通一路直流，信号发生器的正弦就整条被“搬”下去。
concepts: KCL at the summing node 求和点 KCL
description: ±9 V 双电源，接法同反相放大器。IN+ 接 GND，RF（10 kΩ）从求和点 SUM（IN−）接到 OUT；输入 1：开关 S1（a = +9 V，b = GND）→ R1（47 kΩ）→ SUM；输入 2：信号发生器 → R2（10 kΩ）→ SUM。

cards.title: 拨一下开关，整条波掉下去
text: - 在反相放大器的基础上，把 RF 换成 **`10 kΩ`**、RIN 换成 **R2 `10 kΩ`**，再从 IN− 多接一路：**R1 `47 kΩ`** → 开关 **S1** 的公共脚。S1 的 a 侧接 **+9 V**，b 侧接 **GND**。
- 信号发生器：正弦、**`1 kHz`**、幅度 **`1 V`**。CH2 看 OUT。
- **把 S1 从 b 拨到 a**，再拨回来。
波形的大小变了吗？变的是什么？

cards.title: 两股电流在虚地汇合
text: - 求和点 SUM 是虚地（0 V）。每一路输入各自送来一股电流，I1 = V1 / R1，I2 = v2 / R2，互不影响。
- 两股电流在 SUM 汇合（KCL），op-amp（运算放大器）输入不取电流，它们只能一起穿过 RF：
![](fig:sum)
- S1 拨到 a，多了一股恒定的电流，整条波形被往下“搬”一段；拨到 b，这股电流没了，波形回到 0 V 上下。
![](fig:shift)

cards.title: 量两股电流，算输出
text: - 三种状态：① S1→b；② S1→a；③ S1→a，信号改成幅度 **`0.5 V`**、偏置 **`1 V`**。
- ③ 里用电流表（直流档）分别串进 R1、R2，量两股电流，再用它们算输出。
- 最后用万用表直接量 OUT，核对你算的数。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **虚地让每一路输入互不干扰**：多加一路输入，只是多一股电流流进 RF。
- 混音器、电平平移、数模转换器（DAC）都是这个原理。
- **真实电路里**：直接用几个电阻把几路信号连在一起也能“混合”，但各路会互相拉扯；加法器没有这个问题。输出范围仍是 V− 到 V+ − 1.5 V。

caption.text: V_1 来自开关 S1，v_2 来自信号发生器。I_1 和 I_2 在虚地 SUM 汇合，一起穿过 R_F。两路输入谁也不影响谁。

i18n.en: V_1 comes from switch S1, v_2 from the generator. I_1 and I_2 meet at the virtual ground SUM and pass R_F together. Neither input disturbs the other.

caption.text: S1→b：输出是翻转的正弦，绕着 0 V；S1→a：同样的正弦，整条往下移。

i18n.en: S1→b: the output is the flipped sine around 0 V; S1→a: the same sine, moved down as a whole.

en.startNote: **Half-built**: the ±9 V dual supply, LM358, grounded IN+, feedback resistor RF, function generator and scope probe are wired (as in Experiment 2-7). **Why**: what is new in a summer is several inputs meeting at the virtual ground. **Your job**: add the two inputs: slide switch S1 (side a to +9V, side b to GND) through R1 (47kΩ) to pin 2, and the generator through R2 (10kΩ) to pin 2.
en.title: The summing amplifier: adding DC to AC
en.summary: Two inputs meet at a virtual ground through 47 kΩ and 10 kΩ: switch on a DC input and the generator's sine shifts down as a whole.
en.description: ±9 V supply, wired as for the inverting amplifier. IN+ to GND, RF (10 kΩ) from the summing node SUM (IN−) to OUT; input 1: switch S1 (a = +9 V, b = GND) → R1 (47 kΩ) → SUM; input 2: generator → R2 (10 kΩ) → SUM.
hints: Dual supply: two 9 V supplies in series, the middle is GND; the upper one's + to op-amp pin 8, the lower one's − to pin 4. IN+ to GND.
S1: a side to +9 V, b side to GND, common pin through R1 (47 kΩ) to IN−.
Generator + through R2 (10 kΩ) to IN−; RF (10 kΩ) between IN− and OUT.
tests: S1→b (AC only): the output is the inverted signal, average 0 V
S1→a (DC added): same peak-to-peak, the whole wave shifted down
S1→a, signal with 1 V offset: the two DC parts add; both input currents flow through RF

measurements.ask: ② S1→a, amplitude 1 V: OUT to GND on the multimeter's DC range (the average)
measurements.explain: DC part = −10k × 9 / 47k ≈ −1.91 V; the AC part averages to 0.

measurements.ask: Same state: the output's maximum on the scope
measurements.explain: −1.91 V plus the ±0.995 V sine at gain −1: top ≈ −0.92 V, bottom ≈ −2.91 V.

measurements.ask: ③ S1→a, signal 0.5 V amplitude, 1 V offset: the current in R1 (ammeter in series with R1, DC)
measurements.explain: SUM is a virtual ground: I1 = 9 V / 47 kΩ ≈ 0.19 mA.

measurements.ask: Same state: the current in R2 (DC range = the average)
measurements.explain: Average I2 = 1 V × 0.995 / 10 kΩ ≈ 0.10 mA (the 50 Ω output resistance makes it a hair under 0.1 mA).

measurements.ask: From your two current readings, the output average v_o = −RF (I1 + I2) (RF = 10 kΩ)
measurements.explain: Both currents meet at the virtual ground and all pass RF: v_o ≈ −10 kΩ × 0.29 mA ≈ −2.91 V = −(1.91 + 1.00).

cards.title: Flip a switch, the whole wave drops
text: - Start from the inverting amplifier: RF becomes **`10 kΩ`**, RIN becomes **R2 `10 kΩ`**, and one more input goes to IN−: **R1 `47 kΩ`** → the common pin of switch **S1**. S1's a side goes to **+9 V**, its b side to **GND**.
- Generator: sine, **`1 kHz`**, amplitude **`1 V`**. CH2 on OUT.
- **Flip S1 from b to a**, and back.
Did the wave's size change? What did change?

cards.title: Two currents meet at the virtual ground
text: - The summing node SUM is a virtual ground (0 V). Each input sends its own current, I1 = V1 / R1 and I2 = v2 / R2, without disturbing the other.
- They meet at SUM (KCL); the op-amp's input draws nothing, so they have to pass RF together:
![](fig:sum)
- With S1 on a there is one extra steady current and the whole wave is shifted down; on b that current is gone and the wave sits around 0 V again.
![](fig:shift)

cards.title: Measure both currents, work out the output
text: - Three states: ① S1→b; ② S1→a; ③ S1→a with the signal at amplitude **`0.5 V`**, offset **`1 V`**.
- In ③ put the ammeter (DC) in series with R1, then R2, to measure the two currents; then work out the output from them.
- Finally measure OUT directly with the multimeter to check your result.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **The virtual ground keeps the inputs apart**: one more input is just one more current into RF.
- Audio mixers, level shifters and digital-to-analogue converters (DACs) all work this way.
- **In a real circuit**: tying several signals together with plain resistors also "mixes" them, but they pull on each other; the summing amplifier doesn't. The output range is still V− to V+ − 1.5 V.

tests.name: S1→b（只有交流）：输出是反相的信号，平均 0 V
S1→a（加上直流）：峰峰值不变，整条波形下移
S1→a、信号带 1 V 偏置：两路直流相加；两路输入电流全部流过 RF

measurements.ask: ② S1→a、幅度 1 V：万用表直流档测 OUT 对 GND（平均值）
measurements.explain: 直流部分 = −10k × 9 / 47k ≈ −1.91 V；交流部分平均为 0。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：示波器上输出的最大值
③ S1→a、信号幅度 0.5 V 偏置 1 V：R1 的电流（电流表串进 R1，直流档）
measurements.explain: SUM 是虚地：I1 = 9 V / 47 kΩ ≈ 0.19 mA。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：R2 的电流（直流档 = 平均值）
measurements.explain: 平均 I2 = 1 V × 0.995 / 10 kΩ ≈ 0.10 mA（50 Ω 输出电阻让它略小于 0.1 mA）。

measurements.ask: 用你的两个电流读数算输出平均值 v_o = −RF (I1 + I2)（RF = 10 kΩ）
measurements.explain: 两路电流在虚地汇合后全部流过 RF：v_o ≈ −10 kΩ × 0.29 mA ≈ −2.91 V = −(1.91 + 1.00)。

hints: 双电源：两台 9 V 电源串联，中点为 GND；上面那台的 + 接 op-amp（运算放大器）8 脚，下面那台的 − 接 4 脚。IN+ 接 GND。
S1：a 侧接 +9 V，b 侧接 GND，公共脚经 R1（47 kΩ）接 IN−。
信号发生器 + 经 R2（10 kΩ）接 IN−；RF（10 kΩ）在 IN− 和 OUT 之间。
startNote: **半成品**：±9 V 双电源、LM358、IN+ 接地、反馈电阻 RF、信号发生器和示波器探头都已接好（实验 2-7 练过）。**为什么**：加法器的新东西是“几路输入汇到虚地”。**你要做**：加上两路输入：拨动开关 S1（a 侧接 +9V、b 侧接 GND）经 R1（47kΩ）到 2 脚，信号发生器经 R2（10kΩ）到 2 脚。
